title: Phase 56G: UX cleanup closeout and visual review pack

files_changed.note: Closeout doc: summary of 56A-56F, before/after UX delta, manual visual review checklist, remaining UX issues, recommended next phases, merge guidance.
Sanity tests: 56G docs exist, checklist items present, next-phase recommendations correct, no-go claims absent.

56A.title: UX cleanup characterization
56A.headline: Inventory: Help is 302 LOC, project_selector is 185 LOC, New Project form has 17 fields, 'Validated' wording flagged.

56B.title: Help section
56B.headline: Help moved to dedicated Help tab; compact .help-pointer on Overview; 'Validated' -> 'Reference' / 'parity evidence'.

56C.title: New Project v1 form
56C.headline: Inline form reduced to 10 master fields; 11 detailed assumptions moved to hidden inputs (with safe defaults) to be filled later in Inputs.

56D.title: COD derived field
56D.headline: COD auto-derived server-side from construction_start_date + construction_duration_months; manual override is deferred; derived COD always wins when derivable.

56E.title: Project switch simplification
56E.headline: Active project card: project_name is primary label; project_code moved to <details> disclosure; origin pill (Reference / My project / Saved baseline); 'New project' is the primary action.

56F.title: State banner polish
56F.headline: Banner icons: 2-letter codes -> simple Unicode glyphs; .banner-56f modifier class for calmer visual hierarchy (smaller padding, smaller icon, no heavy shadow).

56G.title: UX cleanup closeout and visual review pack
56G.headline: Docs/report/test only; visual review checklist; next-phase recommendation.

help_56B.after: Full Help lives in dedicated Help tab; compact .help-pointer on Overview; 'Validated' rephrased to 'Reference' / 'parity evidence'.

new_project_56C_56D.before: 17 fields, 11 detailed assumptions visible; manual COD date.
new_project_56C_56D.after: 10 master fields visible; 11 detailed assumptions hidden (with safe defaults); COD auto-derived server-side from construction_start_date + construction_duration_months.

project_switch_56E.before: Project code/slug shown as primary line below name; 'Load / Switch' button (debug icon); 'New project' below, ghost style.
project_switch_56E.after: Project code moved to <details> 'Details' disclosure; origin pill (Reference / My project / Saved baseline); 'Switch project' button (product icon); 'New project' is first, primary style.

state_banner_56F.before: 2-letter code icons (FT/AS/SS/...); padding 0.75rem 1rem, icon 28px; bold left border (3px solid).
state_banner_56F.after: Simple Unicode glyphs; padding 0.5rem 0.85rem, icon 22px; softer background, no heavy left rule; .banner-56f modifier class.

visual_review_checklist.state_banner: Banner icon is single Unicode glyph; banner is compact; tone is visually distinguishable; role='status' and aria-label preserved; no debug-style language.
visual_review_checklist.inputs: All 11 detailed financial assumption inputs available; sidebar form (legacy new_project_form.html) unchanged.
visual_review_checklist.scenarios: Save/duplicate/load scenarios work; scenario tab scoped to active project.
visual_review_checklist.audit_validation: Audit/Parity tab shows parity evidence for TUHO/Oborovo; validation summary bar (UI-2.3) renders; G20 BLOCKED, R99/R102 NOT APPROVED preserved; generic projects unvalidated (no positive 'validated' claim).
visual_review_checklist.run_workflow: Run button works; KPI grid updates; last run indicator (UI-2.6) renders; stale result warning (UI-2.5) shows when appropriate; save/run behavior unchanged from 56D.
